reason: This is a large, cross-cutting expression-runtime refactor that introduces a new evaluation context and touches most builtin, vectorized, aggregation, and expression execution paths, plus planner expression rewriting and a privilege interface. Changes at this layer can silently alter SQL semantics, type/coercion behavior, NULL/error handling, or context-dependent evaluation across the system, which is high blast radius and worth a focused Blocker/High review.
